title: Operator sending domain: SES identity, DNS and a configuration set with no tracking
description:
**Milestone:** M1, first slice

**Goal.** SES can send from the new account with SPF, DKIM and DMARC in place, and open and click tracking impossible.

**Build.**
- `infra/notifications/stacks/email.py`, ported from Papyrus `infra/newsletter/papyrus-newsletter-sending.yaml`: domain identity with Easy DKIM (RSA 2048), MAIL FROM `bounce.<domain>`, SPF, DMARC, configuration set `caducus-operators` (reputation metrics on, suppression BOUNCE and COMPLAINT).
- Event destination: EventBridge, default bus (the only bus SES supports), types SEND, DELIVERY, BOUNCE, COMPLAINT, REJECT, DELIVERY_DELAY. Never OPEN or CLICK.
- Domain from the decision in the plan (recommended `notify.anth.us`): a hosted zone in the new account, delegated by one NS record in the anth.us zone. `infra/dns/notify-delegation.yaml` deploys once to papyrus-production with Ryan's approval. Check the zone first: list records and `_dmarc` so nothing collides.

**Acceptance.**
- `aws sesv2 get-email-identity` reads `True SUCCESS SUCCESS` as in Papyrus `infra/newsletter/README.md`.
- A CDK assertion test fails if OPEN or CLICK ever appears in an event destination.

**Depends on:** kanbus-9cc7ec
